components.implementation: Revision-9 transactional semantic revisions for schema-bearing namespaces; schema-directory, namespace-incarnation and FK-connected table witnesses. Table discovery extends only over newly staged entries and clears on rollback/reset. Missing revisions retain conservative file-wide validity. COMMIT still revalidates all predicates and constraints.

A path-owned cache exclusively loans checked ledger/digest state to native transactions, page allocation and admitted inspection. Clean state returns after publication; dirty or uncertain state never becomes authority. Existing inode/header/certificate/rebase checks remain. Detached proof capture and publication serialize mutable wrapper bookkeeping under the Store mutex.

Durable index-generation/configuration/namespace-bound continuations split oversized journal records by primary document family. Row, delete, overwrite and asset effects remain together. Index durability precedes continuation publication. Scalar applied progress and completion seals advance only after the record completes. No-op scan progress is retained without certifying corpus completeness.
